Hi Elena —

Great to hear — glad the demo landed. Quick answers up front and then I’ll loop in pricing/legal to formalize a private offer: 

- Pilot pricing: we can do month-to-month at list with a pilot credit structure (we typically invoice monthly; you can convert credits to a prepaid annual at conversion).
- 12-month prepaid: standard is a 20% list discount for a committed annual purchase; for pilot converts we often extend a 15–20% conversion credit depending on ARR expectations.
- Approvers: procurement + finance signoff is typical; for any elevated SLA or data residency asks, add a security/infosec reviewer.
- Security docs: happy to provide a SOC 2 summary, encryption & retention notes, and a short pack of evidence.

I’m copying Neha for pricing guidance and Marcus for co-sell/partner credit questions so we can produce a private-offer draft and a short checklist of buyer approvers. I’ll aim to get a draft to you by EOD tomorrow.
